name: ctxvigil
description: Multi-view prompt-injection protection layer for LLM web agents. Explainable, deterministic, offline.
//publish: Release decision (ticket 10): TypeScript 5.7+ `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions` produces a real compiled `dist/` (js + d.ts) from the .ts-extension sources, finished by `scripts/fix-dts-imports.mjs` for the one declaration-import case tsc leaves behind. `main`/`exports`/`types` therefore point at ./dist for the pack. The package stays workspace-scoped and must not be claimed as publicly installable until the team explicitly decides to publish (NFR-8).
